reason: Checked against the project rules: no PROTECTED or generated lines, no raster-timed code, no data or table moved (movers_to_update and movers_to_update_raster_y stay declared at &2479/&247C; only this window ever referenced them, and no tool or src references the removed labels update_movers_loop/find_topmost_check_slot_0/found_topmost_mover or um_populate + n).
